nodes.title: Note Prompt Tips
widgets_values:
If you have a long audio and don't want the repeative motions of the character,try following the prompt pattern as shown below(each move seperated by a pipe | , roughly about 5s for each move):


She sang while making a simple heart shape with her hands | She sang while pointing one finger to the left | She sang while gently moving her fists up and down | She sang while gently supporting her chin with one hand | She sang while clapping her hands three times | She sang while pointing one finger to the right | She sang while extending her arms and swaying them from side to side

Here. you could change the 5s empty audio for the tranform video clip to the one you like. You could use the clip and HunYuan Foley to generate the audio and put it here. The link on the video description.
